title: Pick Your Favorite Thing On Three
trend: TikTok 'Pick Your Favorite Thing' couples challenge (items on a table, both partners grab their favorite on three, then react; Virlo rising list, late Oct-Nov 2026, US) + cozy season / first cold nights (heated blankets in US holiday gift searches) — daughter Imani hosts the challenge for her parents; Leon picks the remote over Gwen, they fight over the heated blanket, the dog puts himself on the table; twist: in the final 'favorite person' round Leon grabs Gwen, but only because she is holding the remote, and Gwen picks the dog
youtube_title: Pick your favorite thing on three: the married edition 🛋️
description:
Imani puts the remote, the last slice of pie and the heated blanket on the table and asks her parents to grab their favorite on three. The dog climbs onto the table too.

#cartoon #animation #funny #couples #shorts
tiktok_caption: pick your favorite thing on three: the married edition 🛋️ #cartoon #animation #funny #couples

lines.text: Mom, Dad. Pick your favorite thing on the table. On three.
Easy. I already know what your father is grabbing.
You do not know my heart, Gwen.
Round one. The remote, the last slice of pie, and Mom's good pillow.
One. Two. Three!
Pie. Obviously pie.
Remote. Obviously remote.
Dad. You picked a remote over the pie Mom made.
The pie will be gone tomorrow. The remote is forever.
The remote has been in the couch since August.
And I found it. Every single night. That is called loyalty.
Okay. Round two. Everybody put the stuff back.
The heated blanket, a hot cocoa, and a coupon for one foot rub.
Who is giving the foot rub?
Nobody knows. That is the mystery. One. Two. Three!
Blanket!
Blanket!
Oh no. You both grabbed the blanket.
Let go, Leon. It is set to high. High is mine.
You keep it on high all night. I wake up like a baked potato.
And I wake up with no blanket. Because you roll.
I do not roll. I travel.
Nobody picked the cocoa. The cocoa is sad.
I will take the cocoa. And the coupon. My feet are tired.
Biscuit, get off the table.
No. I put myself on the table. I am round three.
Since when does the dog talk?
Since there was pie on a table and nobody watching it.
Wait. Where is my pie?
Somewhere safe. Inside me.
Fine. Round three. The dog, the coupon, and the cocoa.
One. Two. Three!
Dog!
Dog!
Both of you. Wonderful. I will now pick my favorite.
The mail carrier. Her name is Lorraine. She has treats in her bag.
He has never even been inside her truck!
Not yet.
Okay. Final round. This one is special.
Pick your favorite person in this room. On three.
Oh. Okay. That is a lot of pressure.
No pressure. I have known this answer for twenty years.
One. Two. Three!
Gwen. I pick you. Always you.
Aww. Dad. That is actually sweet.
Leon. I am holding the remote.
Is that the remote? I did not notice. Hand it here.
Dad, you are holding her and looking at the remote.
I can love two things. It is a big heart.
And Mom? Who did you pick?
I picked the dog.
The dog? He ate your pie!
He does not roll. He does not steal the blanket. He listens.
I do listen. Mostly for the fridge.
So I came in behind a dog and a mail carrier.
Lorraine is in another category. She has a truck.
Wait. Nobody picked me. I am right here. I am the host.
Baby, you are not on the table.
Fine. I am getting on the table.
I would pick you. You drop the most food.
Thank you, Biscuit. That is the nicest thing anyone said today.
Okay. Bonus round. Me, the remote, or the blanket. On three.
Blanket.
I did not even count yet.
